title: VErsion Range Specifier (VERS) Type Definition
description: Schema to define the structure of a VErsion Range Specifier (VERS) type.

$schema.title: JSON schema
$schema.description: URL of the JSON schema for VERS type definition.

$id.title: VERS type definition id
$id.description: The unique identifier URI for this VERS type definition.

type.title: VERS type
type.description: The type string for this VERS type.

type_name.title: Type name
type_name.description: The name of this VERS type.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of this VERS type.
examples: Apache Maven dependency version requirement as defined in a Maven POM.
npm dependencies version range as defined in a package.json.
RubyGems version requirement restrictions using restriction operators.

vers_examples.title: VERS examples
vers_examples.description: Examples of valid, canonical VERS ranges for this VERS type.

native_and_vers_examples.title: Examples of Native Version Range and their VERS equivalent
native_and_vers_examples.description: Optional list of examples of valid, native version ranges mapped to their corresponding canonical VERS syntax.

native_range.title: Native Range
native_range.description: Native range for this VERS type.

examples.note: The tilde character means that a version should be at least equal to the version.

reference_urls.title: Reference URLs
reference_urls.description: List of informational reference URLs about this VERS type, such as specifications, reference code and related pointers.

version_definition.title: Version Definition
version_definition.description: Optional definition object for the versions supported by this VERS type.

permitted_characters.title: Permitted characters in versions of this VERS type.
permitted_characters.description: A regular expression (ECMA-262 dialect) defining the 'Permitted characters' for versions of this VERS type.

case_sensitive.title: Case sensitive
case_sensitive.description: true if versions of this VERS type are case sensitive.

normalization_rules.title: Normalization rules
normalization_rules.description: List of rules to normalize versions for this VERS type. These are plain text, unstructured rules as some require programming and cannot be enforced only with a schema. If provided, tools should apply these rules programmatically to create a canonical VERS for this type.
examples: Ignore trailing string after a + when doing comparison

comparison_procedure.title: Version Comparison Procedure
comparison_procedure.description: List of steps describing in plain text the procedure to compare two versions for this VERS type. Comparison also enables sorting constraints for canonical VERS.
examples: Split the version string on punctuations, and letters, yielding parts.
Ignore trailing string after a + when doing comparison.
Compare each part strings from left to right using their lexicographic order.
If any part contains letters (currently only a-z are supported) then that version is considered prerelease.
Versions with a prerelease part in the Nth part sort less than versions with N-1 parts.

examples.title: Version Examples
examples.description: Examples of valid, native versions for this VERS type.

reference_urls.title: Reference URLs
reference_urls.description: List of informational reference URLs about the version definitions for a VERS type, such as specifications, reference code and related pointers.
